question: Why do organic carbon compounds have lower melting points than ionic compounds ?

options.text: Strong force of attraction between molecules
Weak force of attraction between molecules

solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 4**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Since the attractive forces between molecules are **weak,** it doesn't take much energy to disrupt them and thus **organic molecules **have** low melting **and **boiling** **points**. **Ionic compounds**, in general, do not burn in **oxygen**.
